conclusion.explanation: The 403-row candidate seed contains two confirmed duplicate legal identities: the Nordergründe remaining-70% acquisition and the Equans Infra & Mobility/Velian acquisition. Collapsing those duplicates yields 401 unique included transactions. No record-level evidence supports an exclusion solely to force the published 393 or corrected-control 398 totals.

correctedCarryForwardHypothesis.note: The +5 carry-forward correction includes the July Nordergründe appearance, which is the completion of a transaction already represented by the May merger-control filing. After the two confirmed merges and the Equans sector correction, the unexplained variance is one Power & ET, one Transportation, and one Utilities record. Research found no evidence-based exclusions for those three records.

confirmedMergeGroups.rationale: The May merger-control filing and July completion announcement describe the same purchase by Skyborn Renewables of the remaining 70% of Nordergründe, taking Skyborn from 30% to 100%. The July appearance is completion evidence, not a second legal transaction.

evidence.fact: Merger-control disclosure identifies Skyborn's indirect acquisition of 70% and sole control of OWP Nordergründe.
Completion announcement says Skyborn previously owned 30%, acquired the remaining 70%, and now owns 100%.

confirmedMergeGroups.rationale: The January EU merger notice and May completion/rebranding announcement describe the same Aberdeen Investments/DigitalBridge acquisition of Equans Infra & Mobility, subsequently named Velian. The May appearance is completion evidence, not a second legal transaction.

evidence.fact: EU Case M.12329 identifies ABERDEEN / DIGITALBRIDGE GROUP / EQUANS.
Completion announcement identifies the DigitalBridge-controlled vehicle and Aberdeen as buyers and Equans Infra & Mobility as the acquired business, renamed Velian.

archiveAppearanceDuplicatesAlreadyCollap.rationale: Multiple archive-card appearances already map to one seed legacy ID, so the 403-row candidate universe counts this transaction once and requires no further numerical reduction.

correctedControlOmissions.note: The five-card omission explains the arithmetic move from 393 to 398, but one omitted card (Nordergründe) duplicates the already-counted May transaction. Therefore 398 is a control hypothesis, not a record-level truth.

nonCandidatesRemovedBeforeFreeze.note: VoltaGrid, HydePoint/Nymo, Blackstone Digital Infrastructure Trust IPO, World Freight Company, and Sunnyvale DC were removed from the seed before the 403-row freeze as non-infrastructure-fund activity. They are not dispositions within this candidate universe and cannot explain its remaining variance.
